hero_summary.headline: Your openness to experience is low and you value clear, familiar, and verifiable paths.
hero_summary.body_core: When faced with new ideas and new scenarios, you usually don’t rush to jump in. Instead, you first check whether it is stable, necessary, and can be implemented.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When openness is low, you are better at maintaining mature paths and more likely to distance yourself from abstract exploration.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Openness reflects your receptivity to new experiences, abstract concepts, aesthetic change, and multiple interpretive frameworks.
strengths: Pay more attention to realistic constraints
Ability to focus on proven methods
costs: It’s easy to underestimate the long-term value of new perspectives
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You usually prefer to focus on optimizing within a familiar system rather than frequently switching into unknown directions.

core_portrait.identity: Your cognitive system favors robust screening.
core_portrait.default_style: You ask "Is this reliable and necessary" before deciding whether to commit resources to a new idea.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your openness to experience is relatively low, which is more of a cautious, pragmatic cognitive entrance.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your focus should be on retaining sound judgment while leaving room for low-cost experimentation on a small number of high-value new paths.

hero_summary.headline: You're in the mid-range of openness to experience, both open to new perspectives and checking to see if they're available.
hero_summary.body_core: You are not someone who only pursues novelty, nor is you someone who relies entirely on routine; you are more like calibrating back and forth between exploration and implementation.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When openness is in the middle, you can usually understand new ideas, but the depth of your involvement will depend on the situation.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Openness determines how you face new experiences, complex concepts, aesthetic changes, and non-standard answers.
strengths: Will not abandon the boundaries of reality easily
Good for translating between concept and execution
costs: In high-uncertainty tasks a more explicit entry may be needed
Interest is affected by task significance and environmental quality
May be higher and lower in depth of exploration
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You are attracted to new things that have explanatory power, but often still want to know how it relates to real problems.

core_portrait.identity: Your cognitive portal is both exploration and calibration.
core_portrait.default_style: You're willing to understand different answers, but you won't automatically accept them just because they're new.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your openness to experience is close to the middle, indicating that the exploration tendency exists, but it is not a persistent dominant item.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your focus is on turning interesting new perspectives into testable small experiments, rather than staying at the idea level.

hero_summary.headline: Your openness to experience is high and you are more likely to be attracted to complex, novel and ambiguous things.
hero_summary.body_core: You'll naturally look for different interpretations, implicit structures, and new possibilities, and it'll be harder to stay in too narrow a framework for too long.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When openness is high, your advantage is understanding complexity and creating new connections, at the cost of greater need for restraint.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Openness reflects your receptiveness to new experiences, imagination, aesthetics, abstract concepts, and multiple interpretations.
strengths: Be more sensitive to new information and new expressions
costs: May lack patience for repetitive tasks
It is easy to think too deeply or too broadly about problems
Need to actively establish restraint and priority
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You'll see the structure, style, and possibilities behind it when others only see the surface task.

core_portrait.identity: Your cognitive system is more open to exploration.
core_portrait.default_style: You'll be looking for more explanations and a bigger picture, and a greater need to narrow those possibilities down to a handful of key moves.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your openness to experience is more prominent, indicating that exploration, imagination, and conceptual connection are more likely to become your natural entrance.

action_plan.priority_hint: The focus of your actions is not to reduce ideas, but to establish screening mechanisms so that the most valuable exploration can truly advance.
